1. The claimant is in appeal being dissatisfied with the compensation of Rs.1,77,100/-.
2. The occurrence of the accident the liability of the insurer to pay the compensation is not in dispute.

The Tribunal after assessing the medical evidence has assessed the whole body disability at 10%
and after applying the notional income of Rs.6,000/- per month has awarded a sum of Rs.1,77,100/-.

sentences.text: The Tribunal while taking into consideration the fracture that had been suffered by the claimant had rightly assessed the whole body disability at 10%.
5. The Tribunal has taken the notional income of the claimant as Rs.6,000 /-, since there was no evidence to that effect.

As the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority has determined the notional income as Rs.8,000/- for the accident of the year 2013, it would be appropriate to determine the notional income of the claimant at Rs.8,000/-.
6. Consequently, the claimant would be entitled to a sum of Rs.67,200/- (Rs.8,000/- X 12 X 7 X 10%) towards 'loss of future earnings'.

The Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.50,000/-
towards 'pain and suffering' and Rs.15,000/- towards 'loss of amenities'.
In my view, it be appropriate to enhance the said sums to Rs.60,000/- and Rs.40,000/- respectively.

8. The Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.40,500/-
towards 'medical expenses', which is just and proper and is affirmed.

9. The Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.15,200/-
towards 'attendant and conveyance charges'.
Since the claimant was hospitalized for four days, it would be appropriate to award a sum of Rs.20,000/- towards 'attendant and conveyance charges'.
10. The Tribunal has taken the 'loss of income for the laid up period' as one month.

In my view,
having regard to the fact that the claimant was aged 65 years, it would be appropriate to treat the laid up period as four months and award sum of Rs.32,000/-
NC: 2024:KHC:50935 (Rs.8,000/- X 4 months) towards 'loss of income during laid up period'.
11.

Consequently, the award of the Tribunal is modified and the following sums are awarded as compensation:
